correctness.rationale: For every uncolored vertex in part V_i, the open neighborhood is exactly V\V_i; thus a_{i,0}>0 iff every color has positive support outside that part, giving precise feasibility and multinomial enumerator. For functions with zeros, separate fully colored parts F (cost W_F); each color absent from F requires two distinct partial-part incidences. With q=k-W_F>0, available capacities are n_i-1 and the capacitated Hall criterion reduces to sum_{i notin F}min(n_i-1,q)>=2q because min(c,t)/t is nonincreasing in t. This gives exact candidate 2k-W_F or W_F when W_F>=k, plus all-colored N. Constructive placements attain every finite candidate. Independently brute-forced 24 complete multipartite profiles/k parameter combinations through six vertices and k<=3.
